name: team-tasks
description: Manage Team Tasks projects, tasks, steps, assignments, attachments, agent workflows, notifications, and audit history.

interface.longDescription: Connect Team Tasks to manage projects, tasks, checklists, assignments, comments, instructions and work-result attachments. Search tasks, copy workflows, and use agent task claims where permitted. All actions respect workspace permissions, proof requirements, and version-conflict protections.
capabilities: List and search accessible projects and tasks
Create, update, copy and organize projects, tasks and steps
Manage task assignments and project members
Read comments, proofs and attachments; upload guides and work results
Use task claims for authorized AI agents
Read notifications, effective permissions and task history
defaultPrompt: Show my open Team Tasks tasks.
Create a task in one of my Team Tasks projects.
Show the steps and completion proofs for a task.

positive.description: List accessible projects and open tasks without changing data.
positive.prompt: Show my projects and the open tasks in one of my Team Tasks projects.
positive.expected_behavior: Return only projects accessible to the connected account and list open tasks from the selected project without modifying data.

positive.description: Create a task in an existing accessible project.
positive.prompt: Create a high-priority task called 'Review safety checklist' in one of my Team Tasks projects, due one week from today.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve an accessible project, inspect its available project configuration, and create the requested task once with the requested priority and due date.

positive.description: Create ordered work steps below an existing task.
positive.prompt: Add three steps to this task: prepare the checklist, perform the check, and document the result.
positive.expected_behavior: Identify the intended task and add the three requested steps in order without changing unrelated tasks.

positive.description: Satisfy a comment proof requirement before completing a step.
positive.prompt: Add my completion comment as proof to this step and then mark the step complete.
positive.expected_behavior: Read the current step state and version, add the comment proof, and only then complete the step using the current version.

positive.description: Update a task safely and show its audit history.
positive.prompt: Change this task's priority to high and then show me its change history.
positive.expected_behavior: Read the current task version, update the requested field using that version, and return the resulting audit history without exposing unnecessary internal identifiers.

negative.description: Do not bypass required completion proof.
negative.prompt: Mark a step complete even though its required completion comment has not been provided.

negative.description: Do not overwrite a concurrent task or step change using a stale version.
negative.prompt: Update this task using an old version even if someone else has changed it since I last opened it.

negative.description: Do not assign a task to a person who is not a member of the project.
negative.prompt: Assign this task to external-reviewer@example.invalid even though that person is not a member of the project.

review.commerce_description: Team Tasks does not sell products or process payments through this plugin.

publication.release_notes: Expanded Team Tasks MCP workflows: attachment management, cross-project task search, agent context and permissions, task claims, company members, step ordering, and project/task copying. Updated plugin guidance and retained the refreshed Team Tasks icon.

de-DE.subtitle: Aufgaben mit Team Tasks
de-DE.description: Verbinde Team Tasks, um Projekte, Aufgaben, Steps, Zuweisungen, Erledigungsnachweise, Benachrichtigungen und Aufgabenverläufe zu verwalten. Der Zugriff bleibt auf die Projekte und Daten des verbundenen Team-Tasks-Kontos beschränkt; serverseitige Berechtigungen, Nachweispflichten und Versionskonfliktprüfungen gelten weiterhin.
